Mazzy Star - Fade Into You | Live at Shoreline Amphitheater (1994)

🔔 Subscribe to Alt Vault: https://bit.ly/3GcFdaa

📅 Date: October 8, 1994
📍 Venue: Shoreline Amphitheater, Mountain View, CA
🎛️ Tour: So Tonight That I Might See Tour
🎤 Artist: Mazzy Star

✨ Mazzy Star delivers a hypnotic live performance of “Fade Into You,” their iconic dream-pop ballad that defined an era. Recorded during their 1994 tour, this haunting rendition captures Hope Sandoval’s ethereal vocals and David Roback’s mesmerizing guitar, creating a moment of pure atmospheric beauty.

Why Fans Love This Performance:
• “Fade Into You” — A spellbinding live version of Mazzy Star’s most beloved track.
• Hope Sandoval’s haunting vocals and understated stage presence add to the song’s intimate, dreamlike quality.
• A timeless performance that perfectly encapsulates the band’s signature sound and emotional depth.
